{"reason":"Change the medium/high fallback from suggest-alternative-supplier to alert-planner/immediate-expedite-review. It covers the medium 2.8-day and 5.3-day failure rows while replacing 34 costly $45,000 switches with $35,000 always-on-time alerts. Response cost falls from $1,565,000 to $1,225,000, and stockouts should fall from 4 to zero, improving fitness from -2.565 to about -1.225.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
